title: Diagnose and repair a cache regression
prompt: The cache test is failing after an expiry change. Diagnose the cause and implement the smallest robust fix. Do not change the test or its fake clock.

files.src/cache.js: export class Cache { constructor(now=Date.now){this.now=now;this.items=new Map()} set(k,v,ttl){this.items.set(k,{v,expires:this.now()+ttl})} get(k){const x=this.items.get(k); if(!x)return undefined; if(x.expires < this.now()){this.items.delete(k);return undefined} return x.v} }
files.test/cache.test.js: import test from 'node:test'; import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import {Cache} from '../src/cache.js'; test('expires exactly at boundary',()=>{let now=10; const c=new Cache(()=>now); c.set('x',1,5); now=15; assert.equal(c.get('x'),undefined);});
